subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: A florist’s career is considered a good (a) ------- job choice for many people around the world. Florists or floral designers create beautiful arrangements using real or artificial flowers for various events like weddings, birthdays, and even (b) -------. They must understand the meaning and symbolism of each flower, as roses are for romance and tulips are for (c) -------. Though formal degrees are not always required, florists need a strong sense of colour, shape, and design. Many learn through (d) ------- or by attending floral design courses. Above all, a successful florist must have a true passion for flowers and an (e) ------- sense. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) unconventional; (b) funerals; (c) birthdays; (d) apprenticeship; (e) aesthetic;
